attributes.context: This provision appears in Article 3, Management Rights, of a CBA between the City of Walker, Minnesota, and Local Union 346.

extraction_text: The management of the City of Walker, Minnesota and the direction of the working force, including the right to hire, to suspend or discharge for cause, to lay off employees because of lack of work, to make reasonable work assignments, the right to make technology changes, and all other rights relating thereto; except only as may otherwise be provided herein, are vested in the Employer and shall not be abridged.
